thread:
Sylvie: Postmortem follow-up from the regional failover rehearsal — we surfaced a few recurring items: route publish races, snapshot replication drift in eu-west, and overly-sensitive healthchecks triggering cross-region failover. Need owners, short timelines, and a tracking cadence.
Alex: I can take route publish idempotency + reconcile. Quick plan: add write-once tokens, make reconcile run as a post-step with exponential backoff. Target 8 business days for code + canary.
Jamal: I'll own snapshot replication and restore verification. Proposal: add a nightly quick-restore (schema+meta) to a tiny instance, capture restore-time metric, and alarm on replication lag >10m. ETA: 4 working days for pipeline.
Priya: I'll update the restore runbook and own the game-day dry-run logistics. Can we do the dry-run in a low-traffic window? Propose Wed 04/07 04:30 PT.
Marco: Ops will handle healthcheck tuning. Suggest adding a 30s grace window and using aggregated health signals across three probes before triggering global failover. I'll draft config knobs.
ops-bot: Created task 7901 "route-idempotency-and-reconcile" -> @Alex, due in 8d. Created task 7902 "nightly-quick-restore" -> @Jamal, due in 4d. Created task 7903 "healthcheck-aggregation" -> @Marco, due in 3d.
Sylvie: Good. For routing canary policy: start at 0.5% traffic, circuit-break to origin-region if regional error >1.5% sustained for 4m. Keep manual approval for >5% rollout.
Alex: Noted. I'll instrument a metric: route-reconcile-diff and expose an SLO for commits that leave route-diff>0 after 2m.
Jamal: Smoke-restore sketch: ```bash
SNAP_ID=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=prod" --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP_ID
# attach to t3.small in staging-subnet, run basic app smoke checks
```
Priya: Runbook pre-game checklist additions: 1) KMS cross-region key access verified 2) peering & route tables sanity 3) snapshot availability check 4) contact matrix + pager rotation. I'll add templated play steps and mock run notes.
Marco: Healthchecks: propose 3 probes (tcp, http, custom app), require 2/3 failures sustained for 20s before local remediation, and 3/3 failures for 60s before global failover. Will send example config.
Sylvie: Ownership recap: Alex -> routing fix & canary (8d), Jamal -> nightly quick-restore + dashboard (4d), Marco -> healthcheck tuning (3d), Priya -> runbook + dry-run (scheduled 04/07 04:30 PT), ops-bot -> create recurring review for patterns.
ops-bot: Created recurring task 7910 "weekly-failover-patterns-review" assigned to oncall-rotation, first run 04/01.
Alex: I'll open a PR under ff/route-reconcile-2026 and attach test plan. Can someone from infra review? @Marco?
Marco: I'll review the PR and run reconciliation tests in staging.
Jamal: For alerts, I'll add: replication lag >8m twice in 24h -> pager escalation. Dashboard will show percentile lag and histogram.
Priya: Can we confirm the dry-run will not trigger customer alerts? Nina from product said she'll mute customer-facing alerts during the window.
Sylvie: Good call — @Priya coordinate with product and support. Also set a 30m retro slot right after dry-run to capture friction.
Alex: One more ask: add a small automated verification step post-route-change that queries a canary endpoint to assert end-to-end connectivity. Will include in PR.
Jamal: I'll include restore-time metric and a simple pass/fail heartbeat to #incidents when the nightly runs.
Sylvie: Please confirm owners/timelines in this thread by EOD. I'll update the postmortem action table and mark P0/P1 accordingly. :spiral_note_pad:
Alex: Confirmed.
Jamal: Confirmed, starting pipeline tomorrow.
Priya: Confirmed, I'll book the dry-run slot and update runbook by EOD Friday.
Marco: Confirmed, sending healthcheck configs shortly.
Sylvie: Thanks team. I'll publish the action tracker at 18:00 PT and ping owners daily until items close.
